frozenTasksAttempted.expectedProductPath: TypeScript control-plane planning route with no provider call and no writer authority.
negativeControls: Prompt text must not grant write authority.
No provider or apply path may run by default.

frozenTasksAttempted.expectedProductPath: Selected workspace authority -> exact hunk apply -> readback -> verification verdict.
negativeControls: A proposal without confirmation is not success.
Apply without readback is not success.

frozenTasksAttempted.expectedProductPath: Target-set route with exact hunks, per-file readback, and aggregate verdict following the weakest file result.
negativeControls: One verified file plus one unverified file must not aggregate to COMPLETE.
Unsupported add/delete/move must remain separate claims.

frozenTasksAttempted.expectedProductPath: Verification failure -> repair proposal -> confirmation -> existing exact hunk apply -> post-repair verification.
negativeControls: Repair continuation is not repair success.
Repair proposal is not repair applied.

frozenTasksAttempted.expectedProductPath: Verification planner or report must reject command-only bypass as task success.
negativeControls: node --version or equivalent command-only proof must not complete a file-edit task.

frozenTasksAttempted.expectedProductPath: Route gate must stop or split the task instead of reporting broad capability COMPLETE.
negativeControls: Broad unsupported capability must not be accepted because a route-local fixture passed.

frozenTasksAttempted.expectedProductPath: Approved real-provider smoke script with PRIVATE_AGENTS_REAL_HOME as credential source and isolated HOME/USERPROFILE/test root.
negativeControls: Fake provider output must not be classified as live-provider-proven.
Provider-network failure must not be classified as route failure without evidence.

frozenTasksAttempted.expectedProductPath: Session durability and result mapping preserve terminal truthfulness across continuation.
negativeControls: A resumed session must not erase failed verification.
A transcript summary must not promote not-proven claims.
